notablePrerequisites:
Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.
